title: Provide a working staff login form over the existing session API
purpose: Correct audit finding 4: staff cannot authenticate through the shipped login placeholder despite a working session API.
success_outcome: A clean browser can submit credentials through the real login form, receive canonical session cookies and reach the fixed authorized staff page; invalid/rate-limited and technical failures remain recoverable without navigation or credential leakage.
anti_goals: Do not redesign staff pages, create a UI framework, new route/role router, registration/reset/password-recovery flow or new authentication mechanism.
Do not change the existing session JSON shape, cookie attributes, CSRF, role policy, rate limiter, provisioning/session persistence or credential lifecycle.
Do not change Caddy, inventory page/uploader implementation, browser runner/packages/lockfiles, model/runtime deployment or any earlier maintenance task.

forbidden_scope: Auth implementation outside platform/auth/http.py; all session/principal/limiter logic and migrations
TASK-112/TASK-113/TASK-114/TASK-115 cards or implementations, FT-003 docs and unrelated features
stop_conditions: The login flow cannot use existing JSON session/cookie contracts or the fixed landing without changing accepted auth or business authorization.
Real-browser proof cannot run with disposable users/data and clean profile on isolated HTTPS, or requires changing browser runner/dependencies.

constraints: Primary owner is staff_access at src/face_moment/platform/auth/. Keep page rendering and transport in its existing HTTP module; the target inventory capability alone authorizes business actions.

Replace only the placeholder page with a complete small document matching current plain staff HTML: labeled required username and password inputs, password type, username/current-password autocomplete, submit button and accessible error/status region. Use the existing inline-script pattern; add no styling framework or redesign.

On submit prevent normal navigation, send exactly username/password JSON to /api/staff/sessions with same-origin credentials, and handle status 204 without parsing an empty response body. The browser receives the existing cookies; do not read/store/copy the HttpOnly session token or persist passwords. Disable duplicate submissions only while the request is pending and restore controls on failure.

On 204 navigate only to the literal /staff/photo-inventory path. Its canonical page admits photographer/operator/developer; /staff/photo-upload would reject non-photographer staff. Ignore user-controlled return URLs and add no role-routing mechanism. TASK-115 is a prerequisite for this path through the edge.

Map 401 to a generic invalid-credentials message and 429 to a retry-later message; network/non-success technical failures show a generic retryable error and keep the form available without navigation. Keep credentials out of URLs, storage, logs, reflected error messages and retained artifacts.

Use installed playwright cli (available as /usr/local/bin/playwright) with a unique temporary browser session/profile and local isolated HTTPS Caddy/current-source backend. Reuse fixture conventions and TASK-115 edge setup as read-only guidance; do not install a package/runner or modify browser configuration globally. Trust the local fixture certificate only within the disposable browser context.

Provision disposable users via the real owner helper in a fresh migrated fixture database, start without cookies or imported storage state and use real POST /api/staff/sessions for success/401/429; do not fake authentication or preseed a browser session. After login, use the browser-created cookie to open the landing and photographer uploader. Owner repositories/Session API provide session evidence in face_moment.staff_sessions.

The browser check is mandatory verification_targets evidence alongside pytest, even though its fixture URL is generated at execution. Retain the installed CLI command transcript, redacted screenshot/status results and cleanup evidence under the task directory; do not capture plaintext password/cookie values or unredacted HAR bodies. Close only the generated browser/server/Caddy resources and drop only the fixture DB.

Execution records real-page RED before edits and equivalent browser GREEN afterward. The absent form is RED, not an unrelated browser-launch failure. Verify and per-task red-verify precede explicit owner closure; no production or external service is used.
invariants: Only the established session API creates staff sessions and canonical Secure cookies; page code never owns auth or business authorization.
Success has one fixed same-origin landing and failure never navigates; credentials never enter URLs, storage or logs.
Clean-browser success must be proved without manually adding cookies; existing role/CSRF/expiry behavior stays unchanged.
verification_targets: FT-001-AC-013 / REQ-ING-001: installed playwright cli opens /staff/login on the actual local HTTPS backend/edge with an empty profile, fills disposable credentials and submits via keyboard/button; observe real 204, browser-managed cookies, fixed /staff/photo-inventory 200 and photographer /staff/photo-upload 200. Inspect accessible form/error state and existing simple staff-page styling.

FT-001-AC-013 / REQ-SEC-001: real wrong credentials produce visible generic 401 handling without navigation; deterministic fixture rate limits produce visible 429 handling. Network or server failure leaves a usable form and no redirect. The successful 204 path never tries to parse JSON from its empty body or stores the password/session token.

Verify canonical Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite cookie attributes without printing token values, one owner-created active session from the real API, and no browser console/application log/URL credential leakage. Confirm all staff roles can reach the fixed inventory landing while uploader authorization remains photographer-only.

Existing session/logout/expiry/CSRF and edge path tests are regressions only. Use disposable owner-provisioned principals and fixture DB teardown; preserve original AC-007 and TASK-017 proof ownership. Static HTML assertions or direct API sessions do not substitute for the clean-browser login flow.
evidence_required: FT-001-AC-013 RED: the real /staff/login page has no credential form and a clean browser cannot sign in through it; GREEN: the same clean-browser flow submits to the real API, receives 204/cookies and reaches the fixed staff landing/uploader, with observable recoverable 401/429 and technical-failure branches; decisive comparison: actual browser action/response/navigation sequence, canonical cookie attributes and owner session projection; artifact: redacted installed-playwright-cli transcript, screenshot and cleanup record under .tasks/TASK-116-T3-FT-001-W9/.
